scoring_justification: Full recompute of DOS and f-occupation from raw KS-energies/charge density not feasible without raw simulation files; structural audit of DOS features and threshold check on f-occupation against paper-reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Provide thresholds for f occupation and DOS features that match paper's reported results.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: f count ~0.70; Fig.2 shows pseudo-gap at EF and two 4f peaks within +/-0.2 Ryd.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's description and figure; tolerances set to allow numerical differences.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual reported physical properties; using them ensures the checker scores a correct reproduction.

outputs.description: Total density of states per spin direction for CeOs2. The checker verifies the presence of a pseudogap at EF and two 4f‑derived peaks.

schema.description: Single float representing the total 4f occupation on Ce.

outputs.description: Total Ce 4f electron count (both spins). The checker verifies that the value falls within a physically plausible range.

output_contract.notes: The LSDA+U calculation must use U=0.55 Ryd on Ce 4f. The DOS must be computed with the tetrahedron method on a fine k‑mesh. All energies are in Ryd.
